effects.display_name: Mimic Octopus Native Owner, Bucket and Attack State
effects.actual_behavior: Original TamableAnimal owner UUID, Player lookup and allies are reused: owner direct equality, other tameable isOwnedBy(owner) including native null behavior, owner allies, parent fallback. Owner retaliation/attack goals remain native; only custom HurtBy canUse requires tame. UPGRADING AND BUCKET STATE ARE THE SAME NATIVE FIELD: isUpgraded/setUpgraded read/write FROM_BUCKET, not the separately initialized unused UPGRADED accessor. Thus native bucket release setFromBucket(true) admits upgraded attacks; feed upgrade also makes fromBucket true. NBT saves both values from that accessor, and read calls setUpgraded then later setFromBucket, so FromBucket wins for differing supplied values. Do not correct this native behavior or invent an independent upgrade state. Raw mimic ordinal clamps0..4 on read; setMimicState saves previous ordinal only when changed. TRANS_PROGRESS rises/falls .25 to5 after state changes and is read as >=5 attack admission, not pure cosmetic. stop/mimic/camo clocks decrement in tick; StopChange gates state replacement, not every damage callback. Goal AIAttack requires tame/livecurrenttarget/exec0 and rejects StopChange+OVERLAY; canUse decrements positive exec and clears laser. It has no canContinue override, so pinned Goal default calls canUse even during continuation. stop resets scare/flee, sets100+rand200 then overwrites30 when isUpgraded; otherwise clears target/lastHurtBy. Creeper tick writes300 but subsequent stop overwrites30 for upgraded, so 300 is not guaranteed effective full cooldown. Native custom setOrderedToSit writes SITTING only, leaving inherited orderedToSit flag unchanged; Vanilla SitWhenOrderedToGoal alone cannot enforce custom command2. Own travel, owner-follow and native attack admission stay distinct. Tamed hand state-choice/toggle/food/upgrade branches are not owner-only; command/item exchange branch is owner-only. Feeding tamefood consumes first, fishFeeds++; tame only OVERLAY/no block with feeds>5 and1/2 or feeds>8. Upgradefood feeds>5 or feeds>2 and1/2 writes sharedbuckettrue/MIMICUBE/StopChangefalse/blocknull/stop40. Bucket extra MimicOctopusData is written to detached CUSTOM_DATA.copyTag without assigning it back, and native ItemModFishBucket uses BUCKET_ENTITY_DATA then setFromBucket. NBT retains owner/command/sitting/mimic clocks/blocks/feed counts; laser ID/time/scare/exec transient. No generic progression or delayed receipt introduced.

effects.display_name: Snow Leopard Native Stalk, Leap and Two Swipe Frames
effects.actual_behavior: Adult goal requires current target, awake and not sitting, and target alive OR Player. Start stalks beyond 10 for retaliated Player, otherwise beyond 4. Stalk searches the native high vantage point (ten attempts, sampled 8/3/1 offsets) then sneaks to it; target-to-point squared distance >250 triggers recomputation, distance squared <9 and LOS arms leap. Leap on-ground cooldown zero resets 10+nextInt(10), horizontal normalize*.9 plus old motion*.8, vertical+.6; range<3 and LOS requests mobAttack with current ATTACK_DAMAGE value*2.5 and ignores hurt result, then clears stalk. Ordinary pursuit at range<3 chooses 13-tick L/R animation; goal frame5 calls inherited Mob.doHurtTarget. Actor tick independently checks LOS and distance<targetWidth+actorWidth+.6 at frame7, calls inherited doHurtTarget then native yaw +/-90 knockback .5 regardless result. Actor tick has no wrapper server guard for those frame7 requests. Preserve both frames; no once-only latch or successful-hurt knockback gate. Goal stop clears local leap position, stalking and cooldown.

Server SwingArm dispatch can also invoke onLeftClick: item identity + Player attackStrengthScale(.5)>.9F. Parent segment damage decreases1 with native floor2 for player-created child; nonplayer default base5 persists. Chain runs independently of damage return, checking UPDATED progress>=3; if targetsHit>3 retract else nearest valid visible living within8, copied previousTouched list adds only chosen child target. Initial victim is not preinserted, so native chain can revisit it; do not deduplicate native hits. ValidTarget allows nonallied Mob OR remembered lastHurtMob/lastHurtByMob by UUID (fallback can override ally/type test). Child set count+1, from parent, target chosen, position chosenY(.4F), update last then add. Native line trace uses COLLIDER/NONE and rejects different level or distance>128. SWORD_SWEEP explicitly denied; parent other actions retained.

effects.display_name: Void Portal Transport
effects.actual_behavior: Unowned native portal, not damage/explosion. Native type default lifespan300; carver constructors use1200/2000 and onPortalOpen supersedes them; first tick lifespan0 resets2000. Facing gives slab ±1.5 on two axes, ±.15F on normal axis. Query original AABB deflate.2F plus separately VoidWorm inflate1.5, concatenate without dedup. Server destination present, lifespan>20 and tickCount>20 admits not-on-portal-cooldown, notcrouch, nototherportal, getParts==null, notPartEntity, not VOID_PORTAL_IGNORES. VoidWormPart branch can extend lifespan if<22; exact superclass/admission reachability retained for actor reconciliation. VoidWorm teleports to center destination, portal cooldown/resetPortalLogic; actor implementation stays independent. Other entities offset destination by attachmentOpposite*2; if exit dimension resolves and differs by original key reference, cross-dimension route else same-level teleport/cooldown. ServerPlayer cross-dimension native teleport yaw/pitch/empty relative-set, then create sister if absent (no extra player cooldown call in that branch). Nonplayer unRide, native type.create, if nonnull restoreFrom/move/headrot/cooldown/add; discard original even when creation null. Every tick decrement lifespan; <=0 discard. After tick>1 call clearObstructions: once shattered+destination, sets latch and destroys ONLY destination.offset(-1,-1,-1) with drops=true because each native loop bounds is -1..-1; no server guard/mobGriefing/three-cube expansion here. Same-dimension setDestination with no sister creates reverse-facing linked portal; link UUIDs, reciprocal destinations/lifetime; cross-dimension player creates DOWN sister. NBT face/lifespan/shattered/DX-DZ/sister/exit ResourceKey retains native codec fallbackOVERWORLD; transient clear/open/close latches not saved.
